standard_prerequisites.name: The maps between the small and big toposes
standard_prerequisites.statement: a_X and epsilon_X with a_X^{-1}F = epsilon_X^{-1}pi_X^{-1}F, epsilon_{X,*} the identity on underlying presheaves, and pullback by epsilon_X given by fppf sheafification.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the starting point of part (1) at source lines 1157-1163.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of pi_X^{-1}F and its sheaf property
standard_prerequisites.statement: pi_X^{-1}F is computed by Gamma(Y_etale, f_small^{-1}F) and is a sheaf for the fppf (as well as smooth, syntomic, fpqc and ph) topology (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F at source lines 1158-1165.

standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images as associated sheaves
standard_prerequisites.statement: R^p epsilon_{X,*}H is the sheafification of U -> H^p_fppf(U,H) on the small etale site (Cohomology on Sites, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It turns the vanishing into a statement about classes over schemes at source lines 1176-1185.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology agrees over (Spaces/U)_fppf and (Sch/U)_fppf
standard_prerequisites.statement: The restriction identification H^p((Spaces/U)_fppf, -) = H^p((Sch/U)_fppf, -) for U a scheme (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the second identification of the displayed chain at source lines 1193-1194.

standard_prerequisites.name: The scheme case of the comparison
standard_prerequisites.statement: The schemes version of the pullback description and V_n for all n, i.e. the vanishing in the scheme case (Etale Cohomology, declared as tagged source pointers).
standard_prerequisites.use: It finishes part (2) at source lines 1197-1208.

core_obligations: Part (1): identify a_X^{-1}F with the fppf sheaf pi_X^{-1}F, use that epsilon_{X,*} is the identity on underlying presheaves and read off both identities (source lines 1157-1165).
Part (2), reduction: replace the vanishing by a statement about classes xi in H^p_fppf(U, a_X^{-1}F) for U a scheme (source lines 1168-1185).
Part (2), identification: rewrite H^p_fppf(U, a_X^{-1}F) as fppf cohomology over (Sch/U)_fppf via the author's comparison of topologies and the general restriction fact (source lines 1186-1196).

Part (2), conclusion: match (a_X^{-1}F)|_{Sch/U} with the schemes version of the pullback, apply the scheme statement to kill the class on an etale covering, and transport back (source lines 1197-1210).

proof_roadmap.step: Part (1) from the description of pi_X^{-1}F and the identity of epsilon_{X,*} on presheaves.
Announce the reduction of part (2) to schemes, with the author's remark urging the reader to skip the proof.
Rewrite the vanishing for a scheme U and identify fppf cohomology over (Spaces/U)_fppf with that over (Sch/U)_fppf.
Apply the scheme case and transport back to U.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-comparison-fppf-etale at source lines 1144-1154: for a sheaf F on X_etale one has epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F and a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, and for any abelian F one has R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0 (note that, unlike the ph statement, the author asks for no torsion hypothesis here). The author's proof at source lines 1156-1211 proves part (1) from the explicit description of pi_X^{-1} together with the fact that pi_X^{-1}F is already an fppf sheaf (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context), and proves part (2) by reduction to schemes: higher direct images of epsilon_{X,*} are the sheaves associated to U -> H^p_fppf(U,-), every object of the small etale site has a covering by schemes, the fppf cohomology over (Spaces/U)_fppf is identified with that over (Sch/U)_fppf (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies retained as context, plus a general restriction fact declared as a pointer), and the scheme statement (a cross-chapter pointer, used twice) kills the class on an etale covering. The author explicitly urges the reader to skip the proof of part (2); the remark is reproduced verbatim.
